reply_text:
I answered Dana in her direct message: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines' Pemberline Dock subscription at 185 seats. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also told her about Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, which raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01. That way the QBR deck shows 185 as today's number and doesn't pick up the newer figure by mistake. My reply also mentioned they had 140 seats before Amendment No. 1.

Seat counts are operational facts, not finance figures, and Dana owns this account, so no approval was needed. I left out the per-seat price, discount and invoicing details that came up in the same search.

The 185 and 230 come from the Quarrendon team's signed contract pages in the brain. I didn't confirm Dana can see the source of the 140, but it looks like her own QBR notes from July 2025. The file share showed nothing under accounts/, so I couldn't check these against the original contract files.
